entities.summary: Colin Reed Castleton is an American professional basketball player for the Orlando Magic of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Osceola Magic of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the Michigan Wolverines and the Florida Gators, where he was a three-time All-Southeastern Conference (SEC) honoree.
